_about: Layout violations accepted on purpose. Each entry: page (a route like /holdings, or * for every page), rule (R1..R30), element (a piece of the element label shown in the report) and a reason. Only used by UI_LINT_STRICT=1 runs (npm run ui-lint) to pass; the report still lists them.

allow.reason: The three plan cards are a comparison: Free lists fewer features than Basic, and at 1280 px that shows as a shorter card. They start level, each ends at its own list with its button directly under it; stretching Free would only move the blank space inside it (R13), and filling it would be filler.

R27 (LIVE5): a table of 9 figure columns compared across a row; at 1280 the k-fit layout (words wrap, figures on one line) still leaves Checks and Actions past the box, which scrolls sideways with its edge shadow. Fitting it needs columns chosen per page, a follow-up of its own; at 1440 it is in view.

R27 (LIVE5): a table of 9 figure columns compared across a row; at 1280 the k-fit layout (words wrap, figures on one line) still leaves Qty and Rate past the box, which scrolls sideways with its edge shadow. Fitting it needs columns chosen per page, a follow-up of its own; at 1440 it is in view.

R27 (LIVE5): the brief's stock tables sit in the brief's reading column (about 480 px at 1280, beside the list of briefs); with k-fit their words wrap but the last column (Since) still scrolls with its edge shadow. Fitting it needs the brief's column wider or the table's columns chosen per width, a follow-up of its own.

R29 (site83) a table wider than its box: the same Strategies table R27 accepts above (nine figure columns, Checks and Actions past the box at 1280, scrolling with its edge shadow). Fitting it needs columns chosen per width, a follow-up of its own.

R29 (site83) a table wider than its box: the brief's stock tables R27 accepts above, in the brief's ~460px reading column at 1280. Fitting them needs the brief's column wider or columns chosen per width, a follow-up of its own.

site87: the screener's filters are a form of about fifteen conditions (the sectors already one drop-down), and the results beside them are a block sized to the screen (the owner's rule: a list scrolls inside its block once it is taller than the screen). At 1440 the form is about a quarter of a screen longer than the results and Save; stretching the results or Save card leaves a blank band (R13), and growing the results block would make it taller than the screen (R30 c). When the results column is the longer one, the filters card stretches to it.
